vanilla_changes.what: Trial spawner and vault loot tables
vanilla_changes.change: These blocks drop as items when mined with a pickaxe (default on); silk touch only is an option (default off). A spawn egg also drops by default.

getting_started: Mine a trial spawner or vault with a pickaxe.
editor_notes: Spawn egg detail is from the page; verify in-game.
name: Mineable Trial Spawner
summary: Trial spawners and vaults can be mined with a pickaxe and dropped as items. Companion to Mineable Spawner.
